<p align="center"><strong>Ring the season that opens the Halloween threshold.</strong></p>


<p align="center">Beneath the bells, Elias has scratched a verse into the door:</p>

<p align="center">&quot;When harvest ends and masks are worn, the borrowed dead walk until morn. Before the snow, beyond the sun, ring falling leaves and let me run.&quot;</p>

<p align="center">Snowflake, sun or leaf? Your cat claws at an oak leaf beneath the door. The saucer slides across the floor toward it.</p>
